# Cool School Comics

> > Cool School Comics provides NGSS-aligned educational comic strips and lesson packages for teaching science and math to elementary and middle school students.

Cool School Comics specializes in visual learning through cartoon-format educational materials, including bilingual ESL resources and comprehensive lesson packages with Google Slides and assessments. The site serves educators and students with engaging, standards-based content across multiple science disciplines and mathematics.

## Key Topics

- Educational Comics
- NGSS Standards
- Science Education
- Visual Learning
- Physical Science
- Life Science
- Earth & Space Science
- Environmental Science
- Math Comics
- Bilingual/ESL Resources
- Google Slides
- Force and Motion
- Comic-Based Teaching
- Elementary & Middle School
- Lesson Packages

## Shop & Browse Comics

- [Shop Comics](https://coolschoolcomics.com/new-shop): Main shop page for browsing and purchasing educational comics with filtering options.
- [All Comics](https://coolschoolcomics.com/product-category/all-comics): Complete catalog of all Cool School Comics across science and math topics.
- [FREE Comics](https://coolschoolcomics.com/product-category/free-comics): Free NGSS-aligned science comics for home and school use.

## Science Comics by Subject

- [Science Comics](https://coolschoolcomics.com/product-category/science-comics): Science comics category for grades 3-8 covering Earth, life, and physical science.
- [Physical Science Comics](https://coolschoolcomics.com/product-category/physical-science-comics): Physical Science comics in accessible cartoon format for conceptual learning.
- [Life Science Comics](https://coolschoolcomics.com/product-category/life-science-comics): Life Science Comics aligned with NGSS Standards for comic-based science teaching.
- [Earth and Space Science Comics](https://coolschoolcomics.com/product-category/earth-and-space-science-comics): Earth and Space Science comics with illustrated activities for relatable learning.
- [Environmental Science Comics](https://coolschoolcomics.com/product-category/environmental-science-comics): Environmental Science comics on ecosystems, conservation, and sustainability topics.

## Math & ESL Resources

- [Math Comics](https://coolschoolcomics.com/product-category/math-comics): Math Comics for elementary and middle school lessons with visual engagement.
- [ESL Teacher Resources](https://coolschoolcomics.com/product-category/esl-teacher): ESL teacher resources category featuring bilingual educational comics.
- [Fuerza y Movimiento](https://coolschoolcomics.com/product/fuerza-y-movimiento): Bilingual Force and Motion comic for ESL students in English and Spanish.

## Featured Products & Topics

- [Reference Point and Describing Motion](https://coolschoolcomics.com/product/reference-point-and-motion): Force and motion science comic for teaching reference points and movement.
